539-3821-4679-6023-6798.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-3821-4679-6023-6798.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat

116-2645-3257-3430.easyPrerequisites: Kiora's Follower doesn't have summoning sickness.
116-2645-3257-3430.description:
Activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Rakdos Carnarium
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-3755-5457--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-3755-5457--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Selvala triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

339-677-4247-6791.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

277-851-1308-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

215-1753-3043.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with defender.
215-1753-3043.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Axebane Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Axebane Guardian by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

457-1792-4404-5998.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1792-4404-5998.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

204-206-392-1858-2056.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-206-392-1858-2056.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

3490-6723-7075-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-6723-7075-7297.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1069-1169-3228-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1169-3228-5499.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Soldier.
Activate the Soldier by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

413-628-3723.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Carnifex Demon.
When Carnifex Demon dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Carnifex Demon enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

3490-5231-7135.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {R}.
Super Shredder triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2107-4038-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Sunastian Falconer's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.

539-5256-7008.description:
Cast Badgermole Cub by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Badgermole Cub
When Badgermole Cub dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

147-2562-6798.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Graceful Reprieve, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Graceful Reprieve.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 5.

2457-4289-6753-6968.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2173-2932-3967-5220.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2173-2932-3967-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
2173-2932-3967-5220.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

3967-4338-4875.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Conspiracy, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

4593-4659-5070-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token.
When the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter enter, Angelic Chorus triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
4593-4659-5070-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and/or Thopter

804-2533-4681-6797.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Sakashima the Impostor enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat.

413-1429-6792.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Blasting Station and Mm'menon trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Mm'menon trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1018-4067-5527-6281.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
1018-4067-5527-6281.description:
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Skullwinder.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Skullwinder that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Skullwinder token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Skullwinder from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat.

222-527-2292-5295.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2292-5295.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

3525-6566.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand with the mana to cast it minus one colored mana.
3525-6566.description:
Activate Yuna by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next creature spell you cast to enter the battlefield with two additional +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Yuna.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Active Yuna by tapping it, adding one mana of any color and causing the next creature spell you cast to enter the battlefield with two additional +1/+1 counters on it.
Cast any creature spell by casting its mana cost, triggering Yuna an infinite number of times, causing that creature to enter the battlefield with infinite +1/+1 counters on it.

1920-2060-4222-5328-6260.notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Attentive Sunscribe.
1920-2060-4222-5328-6260.description:
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Attentive Sunscribe triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Arwen Undómiel triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Repeat.

1669-5145-5466-5686.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

775-2092-4499.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
775-2092-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Jewel Thief.
When Jewel Thief enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1409-1879-2933-5798.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Drowner of Hope.
1409-1879-2933-5798.description:
Activate Drowner of Hope by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Drowner of Hope trigger, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Drowner of Hope.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

277-774-5621.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Arid Archway.
Activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

977-1329-1594-3152.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
977-1329-1594-3152.description:
Activate Chromatic Star by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Chromatic Star triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Chromatic Star from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Chromatic Star from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

1495-3918-4899.description:
Activate Trazyn using Phyrexian Devourer's ability by exiling the top card of your library, putitng a number of +1/+1 counters on Trazyn equal to the exiled card's mana value.
Repeat step 1 as many times as desired, or until your library is empty.
Activate Trazyn using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 3 as many times as able/desired.

969-2068-4283.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
969-2068-4283.description:
Activate Whisper by tapping and sacrificing it and another nontoken creature you control, targeting any applicable creature card in your graveyard.
Ashnod triggers, copying Whisper's ability, targeting Whisper.
Resolve both Whisper abilities, returning Whisper and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

539-3470-4543.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using no more than one colored mana.
You have enough mana to cast the creature card in hand.
539-3470-4543.description:
Cast the creature card by paying its mana cost.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Lotus Cobra, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning the creature from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Trench Behemoth.
Repeat.

1209-2302-4215-5256.notablePrerequisites:
"Samurai" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
Oathkeeper attached to Filigree Familiar.
1209-2302-4215-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Kozilek.
Kozilek and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Kozilek trigger, shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Kozilek, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Kozilek's power.
Repeat.
